strings.بارجتك الحربية قدّام جزيرة في وسط المحيط: Your battleship lies off an island in the middle of the ocean, with eighteen weapons to choose from for your target, and the enemy fights back with its air defences, tanks and jets.
strings.بارجتك راسية قدّام جزيرة فيها مدينة ومطا: Your battleship lies off an island with a city, an airfield, a port, a refinery and a power station. Pick a weapon and tap the target: a ballistic, cruise or hypersonic missile, artillery and a rocket launcher, a strike jet that drops its bombs and flies back, an attack helicopter, kamikaze drones and drone swarms, a torpedo running under the water, and even a nuclear bomb whose shock wave flattens everything in its path. You can also send a reconnaissance drone to circle the area and mark the enemy's positions before you strike.

strings.وما تلعب لحالك: العدو عنده دفاعات جوية ت: And you are not alone: the enemy has air defences that intercept your missiles, tanks and armoured vehicles moving on the island, and missile launchers and jets that attack your battleship. You can switch the enemy forces off in the settings and try your weapons on a quiet island.
And from that idea, we build a world you can step into.
